_comment: Provider-specific email alias rules. Each rule is based on publicly documented provider behavior. Rules marked 'verified: false' are not confirmed and will NOT be applied — they are placeholders for future research.

plus_addressing.description: Everything after '+' in the local part is ignored.

dot_insensitive.description: Dots in the local part are ignored. 'user.name' == 'username'.

googlemail_alias.description: gmail.com and googlemail.com are treated as the same domain.

plus_addressing.description: Yahoo supports disposable addresses using a base name and keyword (base-keyword@yahoo.com). The '-' separator is Yahoo's variant of plus addressing.

dot_insensitive.description: Yahoo Mail does NOT ignore dots in the local part. 'user.name' and 'username' are different addresses.

plus_addressing.description: Outlook supports plus addressing. Email to user+tag@outlook.com is delivered to user@outlook.com.

dot_insensitive.description: Outlook/Hotmail treats dots as significant. Not confirmed to ignore them.
dot_insensitive.source: Microsoft documentation does not state dot-insensitivity.

dot_insensitive.description: Proton Mail does NOT ignore dots in the local part.

protonmail_domain_alias.description: protonmail.com and proton.me and pm.me resolve to the same mailbox.

plus_addressing.description: Plus addressing behavior for Yandex Mail has not been independently verified. Do not apply.

dot_insensitive.description: Dot sensitivity for Yandex Mail has not been independently verified. Do not apply.

case_insensitive.description: Assumed case-insensitive per RFC 5321 practice, but not explicitly verified for Yandex.
